name: Primal Ring
body:
Aura faint divination; CL 1st; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of the wild. Once the ring is worn, the wearer must make a DC 15 Fortitude saving throw or suffer the effects of baleful polymorph. Each day the ring remains on the wearer’s finger, the DC for the Fortitude saving throw increases by 1.

This ring can only be removed by the casting of remove curse upon it which destroys the ring.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of the wild

Identification DC 26
False Identification DC 16
